title: 24 hours before
description: A calm logistics and preparation pass—not an official interview standard.

items.label: Confirm the schedule, time zone, interview format, and contact path.
Verify the coding or presentation environment named in the invitation.
Review a compact inventory of truthful stories and likely follow-ups.
Review the role and reliable company-provided material relevant to the conversation.
Plan location, power, network, travel, and a reasonable rest window.

title: 15 minutes before
description: A final setup pass that leaves room to settle before the call.

items.label: Check audio and video using the intended device.
Connect power and keep water nearby.
Silence notifications and close unrelated tabs or applications.
Open the interview link and any explicitly permitted blank workspace.
Check lighting, background, seating, and likely interruptions.

title: Coding interview
description: A process checklist for a live problem—not a promise that every round follows this order.

items.label: Restate the problem and clarify inputs, outputs, constraints, and edge cases.
Work a small example and name a correct baseline.
Explain the chosen pattern, invariant, and complexity before implementation.
Implement in verifiable increments while keeping the interviewer oriented.
Test normal, boundary, and adversarial cases; correct mistakes directly.

title: Design interview
description: Works for System Design and ML System Design with track-specific deep dives.

items.label: Clarify users, requirements, constraints, and success measures.
State scale or data assumptions as hypothetical interview assumptions.
Trace one high-level end-to-end path before deep-diving.
Choose the highest-risk component, model boundary, or bottleneck to examine.
Compare alternatives against the clarified requirements and failure modes.

title: Behavioral interview
description: A truthful story structure that stays flexible enough for follow-up questions.

items.label: Choose the closest truthful story with a real decision and personal ownership.
Compress context and state your responsibility clearly.
Explain your actions, decisions, collaboration, and tradeoffs.
Describe an accurate result without inventing measurements.
Add what changed afterward and answer follow-ups directly.

title: Post-interview review
description: A private preparation review; do not record confidential interview material.

items.label: Capture topics and preparation gaps while they are fresh.
Identify one process behavior to keep and one to improve.
Remove confidential or proprietary interview details from notes you may share.
Send a concise follow-up when appropriate through the expected channel.
Return to the preparation plan without guessing at recruiter timelines.
